name: aquasentinel
description: AquaSentinel: a One Health early-warning loop for mosquito-borne disease around urban streams

scripts.setup: python3.11 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r api/requirements.txt && npm install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
